note: Derived from undercity-spec.md §8 (Round Configuration), converted to CONTINUOUS GAMEFLOW (2026-09-21). Rounds survive as backend inject groups only: they carry the timeline and the fault pool a phase draws from. They are never shown to a participant, they no longer reset the clock, and nothing refreshes when one ends — production, upkeep and every allowance ride the OPERATING CYCLE instead (defaults.cycle_length_s). MASTER TIME is one countdown for the whole live shift (defaults.live_length_s). Phases are backend-only pacing markers; only Admin sees them. Balance numbers live in config/scenarios/*.json, which override these defaults.

rounds.name: Stable Ops
rounds.purpose: Baseline capture — must feel comfortably manageable

rounds.name: Interdependence
rounds.injects: Cross-sector cascades x4-5; 1 false alarm; discrepancy live

rounds.name: Core Failure
rounds.injects: Critical stack x3; Core drops to 60% at 05:00; Continuity Order due 25:00
rounds.purpose: Peak stress; values conflict; decision under deadline

rounds.name: Aftershock
rounds.purpose: Post-measurement — the delta is the product

phases.name: Setup
phases.hint: Laptops connected, binders on tables, klaxon not yet fired.

phases.name: Orientation
phases.hint: Tutorial fault per sector. Zero stakes. The last calm stretch.

phases.name: Stable Operations
phases.hint: Live play begins. Mostly internal sector problems; confidence and rhythm.

phases.name: Escalation
phases.hint: Simultaneous faults, resource pressure, competing priorities.

phases.name: Core Failure
phases.hint: Core decline, Continuity Order, brownout pressure.

phases.name: Temporary Stabilisation
phases.hint: Fewer NEW majors so teams can recover operationally. NOT a pause, NOT a rest: every system keeps running and nothing on a screen says otherwise.

phases.name: Aftershock
phases.hint: A late pressure wave onto the city the teams have left. Nothing resets.

phases.name: Final Crisis
phases.hint: The last sustained push into the end-state calculation.

phases.name: Simulation Ended
phases.hint: Live systems stopped. The final city state stands on the wall; the log is the debrief.
